outcome: analgesic requirement in the first 24 hours after surgery
sensory and motor blockade onset time
duration of sensory and motor blockade
cohort: 90 patients scheduled for cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
finding: Intrathecal clonidine prolonged the time to first analgesic request compared to fentanyl, but total analgesic consumption within the first 24 hours post-cesarean section was similar between the fentanyl and clonidine groups.
